{{Top|leg}}
A '''Chartered Starship Engineer''' was a full member of the [[Institute of Starship Engineers]]. Becoming a full member of the Institute allowed the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] to pursue many possibilities in their field, including jobs with career advancements and positions where they could choose their own salary.
